scholarships.official_source: Budapest University of Technology and Economics

existing.description: The stored BME page is an outbound international mobility hub, not an inbound scholarship: it helps current BME students move abroad and lists Erasmus+ study and traineeship mobility, Erasmus Mundus Action 2 partnerships, the European University Alliance Across exchange programme, PIONIER, PRODUCTION doctoral mobility, CEEPUS, the Campus Franco-Hongrois, FÁRAÓ, Fulbright, Swiss-European Mobility, Austrian, Slovak and Turkish schemes, and Stipendium Hungaricum. Separately, BME's own index of current scholarships lists only Hungarian domestic awards for students already enrolled at BME, including New National Excellence Programme, National Scientific Excellence, Doctoral Excellence Grant Programme, Cooperative Doctorate Programme, OTKA, Bolyai, Pro Modus, Public Service, Sport and artistic scholarships, plus the Hungarian-language doctoral completion and habilitation scholarships and the National Excellence Programme public-works variants. No BME scholarship open to international students applying to study in Hungary could be verified on BME's own site.
existing.eligibility_summary: No eligibility criteria could be read for an inbound BME scholarship, because no such programme page exists on bme.hu. The outbound mobility page is aimed at current BME students, and the current-scholarships index is aimed at students already enrolled at BME, many of whom must be Hungarian citizens.
benefits: Not determinable from official pages; no amounts are published for an inbound BME award
coverage: Not determinable from official pages; no amounts are published for an inbound BME award
